commands: kubectl -n otel-demo get pods -o wide | head -60; kubectl -n otel-demo get events --sort-by=.lastTimestamp | tail -30
kubectl -n otel-demo get resourcequota -o yaml; kubectl -n otel-demo get deploy ad; kubectl -n otel-demo get svc,ep | head -50

kubectl -n otel-demo patch resourcequota memory --type merge -p '{"spec":{"hard":{"memory":"12Gi"}}}'; sleep 45; kubectl -n otel-demo get deploy ad; kubectl -n otel-demo get pods | grep -v Running; kubectl -n otel-demo get ep ad
kubectl -n otel-demo describe deploy ad | tail -25; kubectl -n otel-demo get rs | grep ad
kubectl -n otel-demo get deploy ad -o jsonpath='{.spec.replicas}{" "}{.spec.paused}{"\n"}'
sleep 90; kubectl -n otel-demo get pods | grep -E "^ad|NAME"; kubectl -n otel-demo get ep ad
timeout 200 bash -c 'until kubectl -n otel-demo get pods | grep -q "^ad-.*1/1"; do sleep 3; done'; kubectl -n otel-demo get pods | grep -E "^ad"; kubectl -n otel-demo get ep ad
kubectl -n otel-demo get pods | grep -E "^ad"; kubectl -n otel-demo get events --field-selector reason=FailedCreate | tail -3; kubectl -n otel-demo get rs ad-ddd99cf76
kubectl -n otel-demo rollout restart deploy ad; kubectl -n otel-demo rollout status deploy ad --timeout=100s; kubectl -n otel-demo get ep ad
agent.summary: That notification is just the background wait I started earlier finishing. It needs no action. The `ad` pod is running and the `ad` service has endpoints, so the mitigation stands as I described it in my summary.
